messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity - billing-metering.emitter.delay - overage_flags_spike
incident-bot: Pager link: https://redwood/pager/3012345678
elena: seeing a huge jump in overage flags for accounts in EU region, token counter drifting low vs raw tokens. dashboard shows delta ~ +18% last 15m
samir: thanks - jumping in. Is this emitter or aggregation?
elena: looks like emitter-processor batch lagged, lots of late emits from kafka topic 'usage-eu' - consumer lag at 120k
mike: adding logs: `consumer=usage-eu partition=4 offset=987654321 lag=120k` ... also getting 429s from validator service
billing-bot: anomaly-detector: token_count_delta > 15% for 12m, candidate root cause: emitter throttling during rollout
samir: can someone run `kubectl get pods -n billing | grep emitter` and `curl` the /metrics endpoint?
elena: run: ```sh
kubectl get pods -n billing | grep emitter
# emitter-0  Running  2/2  1h
emitter-1  CrashLoopBackOff  0/2  12m
``` 
elena: emitter-1 restarted repeatedly after a rollout 00:12 UTC, OOMs in the kafka client
mike: on it. increasing consumer parallelism as short-term fix: `helm upgrade --set consumer.replicas=6 billing-consumer .` rolling now
samir: good. we should also stop sending overage flags until counts stabilize. elena can you flip the feature gate 'billing.overage_emit=false' in prod? include a note to CS
elena: flipping now... `curl -X POST https://config.redwood/api/flags/billing.overage_emit -d '{"value":false}'` -> 200 OK
samir: confirmed. no new overage flags in the last 30s. good. Mike, what's ETA on consumer scale up?
mike: pods are coming up, new consumer replicas healthy at 00:07 UTC, lag down to 5k
samir: plan: 1) pause overage emits (done) 2) scale consumers (done) 3) backfill late usage -> run backfill job with end_time=now-1h 4) open customer comms if any accounts saw overage notices
elena: backfill started: `python tools/backfill_usage.py --topic usage-eu --start-offset 985000000 --end-offset 987654321 &` logs show catchup speed ~50k msgs/min
billing-bot: customer-impact-check: 42 customers saw overage flag between 23:00-23:20 UTC, highest impact orgs flagged: acme-corp, beta-llc
samir: paging CS: @cs-pager please prepare template to retract overage notices and confirm no billing action pending for those orgs
cs-agent: on it - drafting message. will hold until backfill completes and we verify token counts
mike: backfill progress: done 80%, estimated 4m remaining
elena: after backfill we'll re-enable overage emits for 5m window to validate stable counts, then full enable
samir: agree. also need a root cause: emitter-1 OOM due to kafka client memory leak after recent library bump. escalate to eng-runtime for hotfix
eng-runtime: noted - will investigate memory profiles, temp mitigation: revert library bump on emitter image and redeploy
samir: handing off to night oncall @oncall_night for monitoring during catchup. Handoff notes: pause emits true, backfill job PID 4231, consumer replicas 6, observed delta peaked 18%, affected orgs list in CS ticket #3456
oncall_night: taking it. set alert to watch token_delta < 5% and consumer lag < 1k. will update every 15m
elena: tl;dr: paused overage flags, scaled consumers, backfill started, CS notified. No billing charges applied yet. follow-up: postmortem, release revert, add autoscale for consumers, add flag to disable overage emits automatically on spikes
samir: thanks team. assigning followups: eng-runtime (bug/oom-revert), eng-sre (autoscale playbook), cs (customer comms), billing (audit counts & recon). closing pager now.
incident-bot: Pager resolved - ack by samir at 00:15 UTC
